# `<sl-tab>` — Tab

> **Customized in Saipem DS.** It differs from upstream Shoelace: new attribute `card`. Use only the API below.

Tabs are used inside [tab groups](tab-group.md) to represent and activate [tab panels](tab-panel.md).

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 2.0

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/tab/tab.js';`

**Uses internally (registered automatically):** `<sl-icon-button>`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `panel` | — | `string` | `''` | The name of the tab panel this tab is associated with. The panel must be located in the same tab group. |
| `active` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the tab in an active state. |
| `closable` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Makes the tab closable and shows a close button. |
| `card` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the tab as a bordered card, e.g. for pairing with a trailing `<sl-badge pill>` counter. |
| `disabled` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the tab and prevents selection. |

## Events

Listen with `addEventListener`, `(event-name)` in Angular or `@event-name` in Lit. Data is on `event.detail`.

| Event | `event.detail` | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sl-close` | — | Emitted when the tab is closable and the close button is activated. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| (default) | The tab's label. Can also include a leading `<sl-icon>` and/or a trailing `<sl-badge pill>` counter, e.g. when `card` is set. |

## CSS parts

Parts exist for fine adjustments. Do not use them to change colours, borders or fonts: a missing look is a missing variant of the DS.

| Part | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `base` | The component's base wrapper. |
| `close-button` | The close button, an `<sl-icon-button>`. |
| `close-button__base` | The close button's exported `base` part. |
